title: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 11.0.0-beta before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated attackers to query subscription plans linked to invoices without proper read permission checks. Attackers can craft requests naming invoices outside their access scope to determine subscription membership and view billed plans. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.0, indicating medium severity.
